metadata.question: Did the Jianghan District of Wuhan show lower nightime light intensity on February 4, 2020, compared to January 19, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Jianghan District, Wuhan (approximately 30.6°N, 114.3°E) - Dates: January 19, 2020 and February 4, 2020 - Collection: NOAA VIIRS Nighttime Lights (ee.ImageCollection("NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1")) - This collection has monthly composites with "avg_rad" band for radiance 2. Masking strategy: - Nighttime lights data doesn't require cloud masking as it's already processed into monthly composites - No need to mask; just extract the radiance values 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null/Error: - Valid Zero: Both dates have data and one is lower than the other (A or B) - C1: No images found for one or both dates - C2: Valid pixels = 0 after processing - C3: Invalid results (NaN, None, or out of physical range) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Jianghan District geometry (Wuhan, China) // Approximate bounding box for Jianghan District const jianghanGeometry = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([114.25, 30.55, 114.35, 30.65]); // 2. Load VIIRS Nighttime Lights monthly data const viirsCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1'); // 3. Filter for January 2020 const jan2020 = viirsCollection .filter(ee.Filter.date('2020-01-01', '2020-01-31')) .first(); // 4. Filter for February 2020 const feb2020 = viirsCollection .filter(ee.Filter.date('2020-02-01', '2020-02-29')) .first(); // Check if both images exist const jan2020Exists = jan2020.getInfo() !== null; const feb2020Exists = feb2020.getInfo() !== null; if (!jan2020Exists || !feb2020Exists) { console.log('Jan 2020 exists:', jan2020Exists, 'Feb 2020 exists:', feb2020Exists); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Extract average radiance for January 19, 2020 (using Jan 2020 composite) const jan2020Stats = jan2020 .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: jianghanGeometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const jan2020Value = jan2020Stats.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); // 6. Extract average radiance for February 4, 2020 (using Feb 2020 composite) const feb2020Stats = feb2020 .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: jianghanGeometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const feb2020Value = feb2020Stats.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); // 7. Validate results if (jan2020Value === null || jan2020Value === undefined || isNaN(jan2020Value)) { console.log('Jan 2020 value invalid:', jan2020Value); console.log('C3'); return; } if (feb2020Value === null || feb2020Value === undefined || isNaN(feb2020Value)) { console.log('Feb 2020 value invalid:', feb2020Value); console.log('C3'); return; } // 8. Check pixel counts to detect if valid pixels exist const janPixelCount = jan2020 .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: jianghanGeometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const febPixelCount = feb2020 .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: jianghanGeometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }) .get('avg_rad').getInfo(); if (janPixelCount === 0 || febPixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels - Jan:', janPixelCount, 'Feb:', febPixelCount); console.log('C2'); return; } // 9. Compare and output results console.log('Jan 2020 Radiance:', jan2020Value.toFixed(3), 'nW/cm²/sr (Pixels:', janPixelCount + ')'); console.log('Feb 2020 Radiance:', feb2020Value.toFixed(3), 'nW/cm²/sr (Pixels:', febPixelCount + ')'); // Check if February is lower than January if (feb2020Value < jan2020Value) { console.log('Feb 2020 is lower than Jan 2020'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Feb 2020 is not lower than Jan 2020'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
